message: 釣り堀でスイーツ

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine with just water」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you holding back?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I feel bad letting you treat me to something this expensive just for listening to your troubles」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too late, too late. Your partner's already started digging in」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh. This is good!」
Sacchin and Okamoto-san are eating away without a care in the world.

name: Nanaka
message: 「So just let me treat you without fussing」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pay you back later」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't push yourself. It'll wipe out your food budget, won't it? If you're gonna pay, pay me back once you make it big. Is Mont Blanc okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah. Thanks, Nanaka」
She says to pay her back once I make it big, yet I wonder how much longer Nanaka and I will actually be able to stay together.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gulp. That was delicious~. ...It's sweet, yet that clean aftertaste is exquisite too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I figured you'd say that, so it's already here... wait, it's gone!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks for the meal~. Thanks for ordering it for me~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How did that happen?! I mean, all you guys are doing is stuffing your faces!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Tsk, tsk, tsk, we're in the middle of club activities~」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure can eat. Will you still have room for dinner?」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm in my growing phase, after all」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's always room for dessert~. I have a separate sweets stomach~」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're inhuman」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're supposed to be discussing our exhibit for the Holy Night Festival!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If there are sweets right in front of me, I have to eat them~. Next up is gateau chocolat~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Man, this is awesome!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Since it's originally from a chocolate company, the bitterness of the cacao is exquisite」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We gathered today to come up with an exhibit for the Holy Night Festival, didn't we!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I am thinking. Now that Nana-chan yelled at me, my thoughts retreated back inside」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Liar」

name: Yumil
message: 「How about a fishing pond? My grandpa's friend's cousin runs one, so I might be able to get the know-how」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That has nothing to do with the Sweets Club!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's it! We just need to stash sweets inside the fish. Have them swallow sweets put in plastic bags beforehand」

name: Yumil
message: 「You're sharp today, Sacchin-senpai」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Think seriously!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, listen. After all, making and presenting sweets is the most sensible choice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That might... be true, but...」

name: Yumil
message: 「That's true. It'd be great if we could make something like this~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There are already premade ones, so we don't need to make any. Nobles do not work」

name: Yumil
message: 「As expected of the Queen of Sloths, you're on another level」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Besides, nooone of us can even make sweets」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yep, yep」

name: Synn
message: 「Still totally hopeless as usual, huh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everyone is hopeless comrades together. An ironclad solidarity」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I reject that solidarity!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kuuu. That hit the spot. Thanks for the soba. Mind if I order a coffee?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Do whatever you want already」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「It's on the house. Here you go」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're so thoughtful, miss--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Fuyuka-san, you mustn't. He'll take advantage of any opening he gets」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eating is a serious bout. I have to pay out of my own pocket for sweets worthy of my respect」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Ever so earnest, aren't we」

name: Synn
message: 「I hate to say it, but it wouldn't be fair to the other customers」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「As far as Nanaka-san is concerned, I wouldn't mind paying you a consulting fee, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What are you saying... geez」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「In fact, ever since Nanaka-san started dropping by regularly, our customer count has increased by 50%. It's all thanks to you, Nanaka-san」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My reviews have nothing to do with how many customers come in... Please, don't tease me so much」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sigh... The person herself is always the last to know--」

name: Yumil
message: 「That's what's so great about the prez, y'know」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「In the first place, I hardly think Nanaka-san's palate would change depending on whether I charged you or not」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's why it's about respect. When it comes to store-bought snacks, I show no mercy」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「If you're paying me respect, I suppose I ought to be happy, though. Surely you could let me treat you as a friend once in a while?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hearing you say that makes me happy, but I still can't... You're such a tease. Geez」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No way, Nana-chan. That's where you're supposed to let us tag along on the freebies--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you the one saying that?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because then I'd get treated too--. Since you're the club president, you've gotta look out for your members--」

name: Synn
message: 「You just ruined what was turning into a nice moment!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Ufufu. I can't very well let you fight in front of the sweets, so... I'll leave it at that」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Nanaka-san. Let's go sweets-hopping again sometime」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By all means!」
Before I knew it, the two of them had fallen into a natural, friendly rapport.
Relationships built through sweets... This club is no different.
It's not simply something she's doing just because she likes sweet things.
And yet, why is Nanaka so reluctant to make a cake herself?
It looks like Fuyuka can make cakes on her own, too......

name: Yumil
message: 「Whatcha lookin' at, Sakura-senpai?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. I was just thinking Fuyuka...... looks really cool」
I've heard being a pastry chef takes a lot of physical strength, so for a woman to be able to hold her own in the kitchen is actually pretty rare--maybe it's really impressive.

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you're into that kind of outfit, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not really like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't the outfit! He's into tight, perky asses like that chick's!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--!! Don't lump me in with you, Paqy\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's a bit of a problem for a healthy young guy~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm...... I see, so you're into that kind of uniform. Chocolat's uniform, huh......」

name: Synn
message: 「Hellooo, is anyone listening to me?」
